Interface Droppable

All Known Implementing Classes:
Harvest, Soda, SubaruShirt, SukunaFinger
public interface Droppable
Implemented by items that can appear on the ground and be picked up by walking over them.

When an enemy dies, GameManager may add a dropped item to droppedItemList. Each frame the game loop calls updateAsDroppedItem(double) and renderAsDroppedItem(GraphicsContext) to animate the item. Once the player's hitbox intersects getItemHitBox(), the item is added to the backpack.

Magnet accessories tag items via Item.tag() so they slide toward the player automatically.
